# Pico CSS

Minimal CSS framework for semantic HTML. The classless variant is used, so it
styles standard HTML elements without requiring class names.

- **Source:** <https://github.com/picocss/pico>
- **Version:** 2.1.1
- **Vendored:** 2026-05-15
- **License:** MIT (retained in the banner at the top of the CSS file)

Provides the `GraphicalUi` base styles; the first-party `gui-overrides.css`
layers Luma's theme and widget styles on top.

## Files

- `pico.classless.min.css` — minified classless build (styles semantic HTML
  elements directly); embedded into `graphicalui_assets.hpp`.
